steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

steps.label: up
steps.cmd: docker rm -f spawnables-excalidraw >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --restart unless-stopped --name spawnables-excalidraw -p 8080:8080 -v /opt/spawnables-services/excalidraw:/data excalidraw/excalidraw:latest

notes: the whiteboard, self-hosted, no account and no telemetry. one container serving the official build behind localhost:8080, so the machine owns the tool instead of the tool owning the machine. honest gap: the image tag is latest at draft time, so the card says unpinned rather than pretending a version it has not checked.
